title: Playing hymns and church jobs with brass bands
summary: Asked about churches, he says brass bands of fifteen pieces played hymns and describes the instrumentation.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Well tell me this, did you ever play for any churches in New Orleans? Sometime back I heard a jazz combo playing hymns. We played hymns in the church, yeah.
Because I played, like I tell you, I played Osfio and you could play hymns sometimes.

When they get rally you could play hymns too. And you'd go to the churches too? Oh yeah, sure. I mean did all of you combo the same group that played church jobs? No, that was the brass bands. Oh. The brass bands. Oh yeah.

We used nothing less than fifteen pieces. We used two trumpets, sometimes three trumpets. Then we used trombone, we used clarinet, we used bass, we used the drum, the two drums, you know, the two different man playing. Of course the snare drum and we call it the kittle drum and the bass drum.
